card.name: Words leading into injury or trauma terms
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected injury, wound or trauma term, such as 'Head' before Injury, 'open' before heart surgery or surfaces, and 'first' in burn therapy timing.

card.writes: It pushes toward injury and trauma words and away from infection and complication words.
card.plain: It fires on words that come right before an injury, burn or surgical wound is named.
